reports.title: Yesway, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Full Year 2026 Outlook
section: The Company has reaffirmed its outlook for the following metrics as detailed below:

Adjusted EBITDA | $235 million - $245 million
Same-store Inside Merchandise Sales Growth | 1.25% - 3.25%
Capital Expenditures | $85 million - $95 million
New Store Openings | 6 – 8 new stores
